title: 卑尔维斯·紫金深空
description: 蝠鲼形卑尔维斯平稳悬停，宽大翼鳍与长尾完整入框，紫金光线分出庄重的非人轮廓而无恐怖细节。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Bel'Veth is a colossal manta-like Void empress with sweeping purple wing-fins, a long tapering tail, pale gold accents, and a small crowned humanoid-looking head above the broad ray body. Preserve the distinctive ray anatomy and elegant fin geometry, never substituting a human body. Keep the face composed and the underside closed, without exposed maw, frightening teeth, injury, or realistic horror.
art_direction.scene: Show her hovering motionless above a wide reflective stone basin, broad fins extended in a controlled symmetrical span and the long tail curving clearly below. One tall distant monolith establishes scale. A concentrated gold sidelight cuts across purple wax-crayon facets, while a clean dark-to-pale atmospheric gradient gives the unusual silhouette monumental depth without a menacing approach.
art_direction.palette: royal purple, plum shadow, muted gold, pale lilac
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
